sections.heading: What is trending: “outlook outage”
paragraphs: “outlook outage” appeared on Google Trends' Trending Now list for AU (snapshot taken 2026-08-31T23:50:58+00:00 UTC). Google reports at least 100 searches for this term — that figure is a lower bound published in the official Trends feed, not an exact count.

sections.heading: What's behind the spike — the coverage
paragraphs: The Trends feed associates this search spike with 3 news stories from CNET, GV Wire, Houston Chronicle. The headlines, exactly as published:
list: “Microsoft Outlook Hit by Exchange Online Service Outage” — CNET
“Microsoft Outlook Down for Thousands of Users, Downdetector Reports” — GV Wire

sections.heading: Timeline
paragraphs: The trend entry was published to the Google Trends feed at Mon, 31 Aug 2026 16:30:00 -0700. Our snapshot was taken at 2026-08-31T23:50:58+00:00 UTC and this briefing was assembled at 2026-08-31T23:52:11+00:00 UTC.

sections.heading: How to read these numbers
paragraphs: Google Trends reports approximate search volume as a lower bound (for example “20K+”). Actual volume can be significantly higher. Trending status reflects acceleration in searches, not the absolute size of a topic. For the full story behind the spike, read the cited coverage below — this briefing intentionally adds no speculation beyond the sourced facts.
